Pick a learner below. The Hifz report is built live from the Name/Grade/Attendance/Tajweed/Dua/Hifz marks entered on the Exam tab and the Term Juz figures on the Summary tab, placed under whichever term column matches the "Term" field in the masthead above (e.g. "Term 1 2026" fills the Term 1 column). Other cells (Average Daily Sabaq, Average Daily Dhor, Hifz Class Re-opens, Comments, Signatures) can be filled in by hand.

Learner Report

Name, Grade and Performance Status are linked live from the Exam tab; Weekly Progress and the Term Summary are linked live from the Week tabs/Summary tab. The Discipline Log is specific to this tab and is saved with the dashboard. The Written Report below is also used to pre-fill the General Comments box on the Exam Term Report tab.
